summary_1line: Sanjaya explains the ancestral feud behind Bhurisravas humiliating Satyaki, then describes Arjuna racing at sunset through Kaurava warriors to reach Jayadratha.

image_candidates.scene_text: In the crowded swayamvara arena, Sini throws Somadatta to the ground, seizes his hair, and places a foot upon him before thousands of watching kings.
Arjuna’s chariot with white horses charges through a storm of arrows as the red sun sinks low while Kaurava warriors encircle him to protect Jayadratha.
Karna stands alone in his chariot, body bloodied by arrows, still firing fiercely while Arjuna, Bhima, and Satyaki attack him together.
